title: Hawaii (HI) Counties
text:
Hawaii (HI) Counties

FIPS codes for Hawaii.
FIPS State Code: 15

Enter the U.S. country code (01) followed by the state and county code.

 For example, for Maui County, enter 
01-15009.

| FIPS County Code | County Name |
| --- | --- |
| 001 | Hawaii County |
| 003 | Honolulu |
| 005 | Kalawao |
| 007 | Kauai |
| 009 | Maui |
